notes.content:
[h2]Dear Astronauts,[/h2]

[b]PLEASE ENJOY THE MULTIPLE PLANETS, MECHANICS, AND CHAOTIC FIGHTS YOU'LL HAVE WITH THE WORLD EATER! WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU, SO IF YOU'VE PLAYED, PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW ❤️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485011/6b9ab06a61d9183f2593a85a4c0cef544913711d.gif[/img]

We are incredibly proud to announce the release of our latest game WORLD EATER. What started as a school project has turned into a milestone for each and every one of us. We really hope you enjoy the fights, achievements and areas we've crafted for you. If there's any bugs or issues you're encountering, please do open a ticket with us in the discord to let us know about it, so we can try our best to fix it ASAP!

[b]Thanks again for playing!

~ The WORLD EATER Team ❤️[/b]

notes.title: V0.9.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Camera Targeting & Balancing Update (V0.9.1.0)[/h2]

[h2]New Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Switchable Camera Targeting Settings,
Clicking middle mouse button during gameplay will switch the camera target settings,
[*] Added some foliage to Phase 2,
[*] Added some general decoration to Phase 3,
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Heavy attack does less damage & headshot damage,
[*] Heavy attack has a bit of added range,
[*] Ending cinematic has improved camera work as well as some other improvements,
[*] Improved boss knockback accuracy and amount,
[/list]

[h2]Fixed Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player unfreezing during heavy attack when hit by boss,
[*] Lighting in scenes wasn't accurate to the suns positions,
[*] Fixed boss being hittable in weird places when underground or flying trough the air,
[*] Fixed cutscenes having jetpack exhaust,
[*] Fixed settings menu not having even padding,
[*] Fixed Hall of Fame items disappearing,
[*] Boss now disappears in planet exploding cutscene,
[*] Improved boss being invinsible sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: V0.9 Release Date
notes.content:
We're incredibly excited to announce the V0.9 release date for WORLD EATER!

As you've seen in both the title and the description, we are talking about a V0.9 release and not yet the full 1.0. The WORLD EATER team is hard at work to make sure you guys get access to the game we've been building over the past year, but we also really want to add more mechanics and other fun stuff for you guys to play around with!

That's why we've decided on an earlier release, so we can get this game into the hands of people and get some feedback on it!

The full V1.0 release is currently planned for [b]Q3 2025[/b], so be sure to look forward to more fights with the infamous WORLD EATER.

- WORLD EATER Team
